workflow.meaning: All four frozen profile diagnostics completed and passed diagnostic-completeness assertions; workflow success is not production qualification.

interpretation: Across the complete frozen A2 O14 profile set, the first reproducibly established competing event is the 1 cm surface-storage cap, not isolated top-node h0=0 saturation.

The top node remains materially negative at cap onset in every representative root, from -0.146 cm to -1.472 cm; these are not near-simultaneous top-saturation coevents under the frozen classification.
All 12 deterministic starts converge into the same reproducible cap-event cluster for the one passing 12*KSAT case in each profile, making the event ordering robust to the frozen start topology.
Independent high-accuracy surface-reference recomputation closes the water balances within 1.37e-11 cm worst-case, well inside the unchanged 1e-9 cm gate.

This explains why A2/A3 could not establish an isolated O14 h0=0 event inside the pre-runoff S<1 cm topology. It does not yet qualify runoff continuation or the later top-saturation event after runoff starts.
hard_guards: Preserve A3 negative isolated-h0 event evidence; do not reinterpret it as solver failure.
Do not alter the frozen O14 material parameters or qualified 5 cm surface-face law.
Runoff onset must be a conservative transfer, never clipping of surface storage.
A5 must checkpoint at the cap event, then continue from the committed cap state with S fixed at the cap and explicit runoff ledger ownership.
Rejected post-cap trials may not mutate the committed cap state or runoff ledger.
Do not assume the later top-saturation event exists until independently demonstrated after runoff onset.

architecture_checks.transactionality: All A4 trials are scratch-only and leave committed state unchanged.
architecture_checks.mass_conservation: Independent-reference balances remain below 1e-9 cm with no mass repair.
architecture_checks.physics_solver_policy_separation: Only event ordering was changed; Ross physics and forcing cases remained frozen.
architecture_checks.runtime_composition: The result identifies surface-cap/runoff onset as a runtime/coupler event outside the soil-face kernel.

hard_nonclaims: No later O14 top-node saturation event qualification.
No response tangent, MultiSWAP, runtime or groundwater admission.
